spec.description: HTTP service metrics for request rate, latency, and errors

spec.expr: sum by (method, path) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum{instance=~"$instance",job=~"$job",service_name=~"$service",method=~"$method",status_code=~"$status_code"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (method, path) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{instance=~"$instance",job=~"$job",service_name=~"$service",method=~"$method",status_code=~"$status_code"}[$__rate_interval])), 1)

spec.title: HTTP Service Metrics
